source.review: C1-06 wave 3 — spells that needed the revive, maximum-hp and dispel kinds, Death Ward, the Mage Armor AC formula, spent-on-hit riders (smites), retaliation and summons. Each executionScope states what the runtime enforces.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-06): the touched creature returns to life with 1 HP; death saves reset. The one-minute limit since death and the exclusions (old age, missing body parts) are left to the DM.

Authored (C1-06): the touched creature returns to life with 1 HP. The one-hour casting time is recorded; the ten-day limit, the −4 penalty that fades over four long rests, and the disease/curse rules are left to the DM.
Authored (C1-06): the touched creature returns to life with all its HP. The century limit, the −4 penalty and the caster's exhaustion for a creature dead over a year are left to the DM.
Authored (C1-06): the touched creature returns to life with all its HP, and Poisoned and Exhaustion end. Creating a new body and the 200-year limit are left to the DM.
Authored (C1-06): the creature returns to life with all its HP in the same character record. The new species rolled on the Reincarnate table is applied by the DM on the sheet.
Authored (C1-06): up to three creatures gain +5 HP maximum and +5 current HP, +5 per slot level above 2nd. The 8-hour end, when the maximum returns to normal, is applied by the DM (재정비 or the sheet).

primary.summary: 대상이 0 HP로 떨어질 피해를 받으면 대신 1 HP로 남고 주문이 끝난다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-06): for 8 hours the first damage that would reduce the warded creature to 0 HP leaves it at 1 HP and ends the spell. The instant-death clause (the ward negates the killing effect) is judged by the DM.

Authored (C1-06): every spell effect on the chosen creature ends. The SRD only ends spells of 3rd level or lower automatically and asks for a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + spell level) for higher ones; the runtime ends them all, so the DM re-applies any that should survive. Objects and magical effects that are not spells are left to the DM.

primary.summary: 갑옷을 입지 않은 대상의 기본 AC가 13 + 민첩 수정치가 된다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-06): for 8 hours the target's AC is judged as at least 13 + its DEX save modifier (the runtime's stand-in for the DEX modifier; a creature proficient in DEX saves gets its proficiency bonus too). The armor restriction and the early end when armor is donned are left to the DM.

primary.summary: 이동의 자유: 어려운 지형과 마법적 속박에 영향받지 않으며 붙잡힘·포박이 끝난다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-06): the Grappled and Restrained conditions on the touched creature end, and the spell is tracked for 1 hour. Ignoring difficult terrain, magical speed reduction and the underwater rule are narrated.

primary.summary: 오라 안의 아군은 사령 피해에 저항을 얻고 최대 HP가 줄지 않으며, 0 HP인 아군은 턴 시작에 1 HP를 되찾는다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-06): chosen allies within the 30-foot emanation have resistance to necrotic damage while the caster concentrates (up to 10 minutes). The HP-maximum protection and the 1 HP at the start of a 0-HP ally's turn are applied by the DM.

Authored (C1-06): creatures on the ground in the 100-foot-radius circle make a DEX save; on a failure they fall Prone. The difficult terrain, the concentration checks, fissures and collapsing structures are narrated by the DM.

primary.summary: 다음 무기·맨손 명중에 광휘 피해 2d8(슬롯 레벨당 +1d8)을 더한다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-06): cast as a bonus action, the next melee weapon or unarmed hit within a minute deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage, +1d8 per slot level above 1st, and the rider is spent. The SRD casts it after the hit lands; the runtime asks for it before the attack. The extra 1d8 against Fiends and Undead is added with 서술 피해.

primary.summary: 다음 무기 명중에 광휘 피해 2d6(슬롯 레벨당 +1d6)을 더하고 대상이 빛을 낸다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-06): the next melee weapon or unarmed hit deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage, +1d6 per slot level above 2nd, and the rider is spent. The SRD casts it after the hit; the runtime asks for it before. The 5-foot light and the loss of Invisible on the target are narrated.

primary.summary: 시체 하나를 스켈레톤(또는 좀비)으로 일으켜 24시간 동안 부린다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-06): the cast adds one Skeleton to the scene on the caster's side, plus two per slot level above 3rd. The SRD lets the caster choose a Zombie for a corpse; the runtime always raises a Skeleton (add a Zombie from 인카운터 instead). The 24-hour control and the bonus-action commands are narrated.

primary.summary: 시체 셋을 구울로 일으켜 24시간 동안 부린다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-06): the cast adds three Ghouls to the scene on the caster's side. The higher-slot options (four Ghouls or three Ghasts/Wights at 7th, five Ghouls or three Ghasts/Wights or two Mummies at 8th…) are added from 인카운터. The 24-hour control is narrated.
